version.description: DESC-9. A single integer counting breaking changes to this Capability alone. There is no minor version.

address.title: Address
address.description: DESC-12. An absolute https URL, or a relative reference resolved against the Descriptor's own URL. DESC-13 governs whether a credential may be sent to one that is off-origin.

title: Health capability entry
description: HLTH-1. The shared Capability entry with the address required, because `health` is answered over HTTP. DESC-22 makes the address optional in the shared entry only so that `events`, answered over a broker, can be declared at all.
